purpose: Replace owner-local witness-wide linear scans with a private bounded request-id index, retaining the existing selected-grant scope, checksums, uncertainty, capacity and lifecycle contracts.

selection.finiteScope: One product-source change plus one new five-case declared-store entry and this result.
selection.reason: The current owner linearly scans its known-record witness array for every lookup and again for an intent upgrade. Repeated full-capacity recovery therefore repeats witness-wide application loops. This packet replaces those loops; missing coverage is not the novelty claim.
selection.preservedOldOutcomes: The prior eight declared-store and three actual-V3-SQLite selected outcomes remain pinned to the earlier 37342-byte owner. They were not replayed or relabeled as current-source native evidence.

implementation.storage: One private native Map per owner, keyed by requestId within the immutable selected grant. The stored witness still includes grantId and lookup also checks that exact grant.
implementation.invariant: All observation entry points retain their existing requireScope fence before witness lookup or mutation.
implementation.bound: At most custodyPolicy.maxRequests distinct selected-grant keys; an upgrade of an existing key does not consume another slot.
implementation.retainedData: Detached frozen key/checksum witnesses only, never bodies, proofs, response receipts or dispatch authority.
unchanged: Original/intent checksum comparison and sticky custody uncertainty
Submission tracking entries and their existing lookup path
Store ownership, close Promise identity, callback counters and default opt-in behavior
implementation.mapAndPristineIntrinsicBehavior: Retained native premises, not newly qualified against hostile global intrinsic mutation.

optimization.established: The explicit knownRecords-wide lookup and replacement loops are removed from the application source.
notEstablished: Native Map worst-case complexity or bounded latency
optimization.observedSelectedLoad: Each of V2 and V3 validates 1024 distinct witnesses, rereads them in reverse order and observes one retained key after capacity refusal.
optimization.runtimePinReuse: Retained whole-binary digests reused only after exact unchanged file-identity tuples.

sourceBinding.productionDependencies: Only the unchanged original-request-custody contract and reviewed Node builtins; package scope is pinned.

scenarios.name: V2 maximum-capacity witness index preserves reverse reads and capacity refusal
asserts: V2 retains 1024 selected keys, preserves reverse-read original bytes, and refuses a 1025th distinct observation.
A legitimate unobserved null remains data; restored reads after overflow retain custody uncertainty. No retain or dispatch occurs.

scenarios.name: V3 maximum-capacity witness index preserves original and intent checksums
asserts: V3 performs the same capacity/reverse-read lifecycle with exact original and intent checksums.
Overflow latches UNKNOWN and blocks new submission before store methods or callbacks.

scenarios.name: full index upgrades one known intent without allocating another witness slot
asserts: At maxRequests=1, repeated observation and no-intent -> known-intent upgrade do not allocate another witness slot.
A plain original read does not erase the known intent witness. Missing intent latches UNKNOWN; restored intent bytes do not clear it.

scenarios.name: indexed original checksum changes remain sticky after restored data
asserts: Two indexed keys include constructor and toString.
A valid but changed original plus matching replacement intent is rejected by the old witness. Restoring both exact records does not clear uncertainty.

scenarios.name: prototype-named request ids and foreign grants preserve the normal V3 lifecycle
asserts: A foreign grant with the same requestId is rejected before any store method, without poisoning the selected owner.
constructor/toString requests submit normally, preserve two-original counters and repeated recovery bytes, and close DRAINED.
Callback completion is declared local behavior, not service delivery or durable response evidence.

callsite.timeoutBoundary: Not a hard native lifetime, cancellation, cleanup, OS or network sandbox guarantee.

preservation.protectedSourceExclusion: Only the explicitly edited 37342-byte owner row is removed from the current unchanged cohort; its immutable parent and earlier execution records remain untouched.
preservation.scratch: CLEANED, zero bytes, only the registered empty stream directory; no protected evidence deleted.
preservation.quotaBoundary: Cooperative sampled accounting, not an OS-enforced aggregate quota.

metadataReaderIssue.correction: Verify and decode the fixed immutable ancestry once per inspection; reuse the verified rows for before/after seal comparisons. All current retained file pins are still checked in full.

authority.pr193: VALIDATED exact-same-signed-block resend remains distinct from UNKNOWN and ACKNOWLEDGED.
